en-US.whatsNew:
Search results open in one go, and the app now starts where you left off: at your last search as well as at your last text.

Listening to search results, you hear each sutta's name before its quotes, so you know when the next sutta begins.

Also: changing the text size keeps your place in the text; in the columns view, when one language is hidden the other takes the full width; a long tap on the dictionary button opens DharmaMitra's grammar analysis of the word; the Memorize page's play button keeps its size offline.
